cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lunch with just me. That disastrous reunion finally taught you what I meant about taking turns.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you got a whole sentence out once the audience had gone. Progress. You always used to play to the crowd.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. Then you can finish that sentence without winning the room first. I'm giving you all of my turn.

reason: Replace the removable teaching prefaces with pupil corrections that directly change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve the specific partner contribution and make the ending answer it.
